Commentary.Commentary: So, that wraps up the formalities of this game. The series has gone well and now the decider is set to be a cracking one. Join us on 24th March at 0930 local (0400 GMT) to catch all the action. Until next time, it's goodbye from us. Cheers!

IRELAND SKIPPER, WILLIAM PORTERFIELD  is relieved at the victory. Says that the last two games were must-win games and the next one is no different. Opines that bowling a side out on such pitches isn't easy and is proud of his bowlers for doing the job. Praises Kevin O'Brien for the knock and his stand with Gary Wilson. States that there have been some forced changes in the squad and adds that Kevin's condition will be assessed before taking a call for the next game.

AFGHANISTAN SKIPPER, ASGHAR STANIKZAI says it was a good batting wicket. Credits Kevin O'Brien for the way he batted in spite of being injured. Adds he is not happy with the batting performance of his side but is really proud of the efforts shown by 7. 8. 9, 10 batsmen. Ends by saying Ireland have come back well and he hopes Afghanistan do well in the series decider.

MAN OF THE MATCH, KEVIN O'BRIEN says he's not feeling well at the moment but is happy to take his team over the line. Adds Afghanistan are a good bowling team and agrees they knew the Afghans won't give it away easily. Is delighted to finish it off for his side today.

Nabi was the pick of the Afghanistani bowlers with a 4-fer while Naib was tidy as well. However, the other bowlers weren't able to create constant pressure. Stanikzai's main weapon Rashid Khan did pick up two wickets but wasn't threatening at all and leaked runs as well with O'Brien taking a special liking to the leggie. Earlier in the day, Afghanistan's lower order saved them the blushes after O'Brien's heroics had led the Irish charge to reduce the hosts to 83/7 at one stage. However, the total was at least 20-25 runs short.

Excellent win for Ireland and they have stretched the series to the decider. Chasing a moderate target of 221, they got off to a steady start but Nabi's introduction changed things as they started to stutter in the chase. 48/0 became 102/4 and to make matters worse, Kevin O'Brien had retired hurt as well. It seemed like the chase was getting derailed but once O'Brien returned, things changed. He played an exceptional knock, staying till the end to guide his side home. His 66-run stand with Wilson turned the game on its head.

FOUR! Kevin O'Brien seals the deal for his side and levels the series 2-2! It all started with him this morning and has ended with him, whattey all rounder! A low full toss on the pads, Kevin O'Brien flicks it neatly through square leg and the ball races away to the fence for a boundary. IRELAND WIN BY 3 WICKETS AND 19 BALLS TO SPARE!
FOUR! That will do! What a hit that is! Zadran hurls in a length delivery on middle, Kevin O'Brien stays back and mauls the pull through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Bangs in a short ball down the leg side, Dockrell misses his glance as the ball goes off the gloves towards the leg side for a single.
Angled in on the pads, Kevin O'Brien tucks it in front of square for a single.
On a length, slower in pace, Kevin defends it back down the wicket.
Around middle, whipped through the leg side for a single. Just 7 needed from 4 overs now!
Another googly around off, Kevin O'Brien comes forward to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. A loud, loud appeal for LBW but it's turned down. Maybe, the impact was just outside the line.

FOUR! Almost a wicket! Rashid bowls a googly around off, Kevin looks to drive it through but gets a thick inside edge which rolls past the leg pole and races down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. The tourists won't mind it at all.
Once again it's flat and short outside off, Dockrell cuts it behind point for one more.
Flatter outside off, cut through backward point for a single.
Full around middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a single.

FOUR! IS THAT A DROPPED CHANCE? Seems so as Zadran is livid at the effort! Usman Ghani the culprit! Back of a length ball outside off, Kevin sees the width and goes after it. Gets a thick outside edge towards short third man where Ghani is late to react and to make the matters worse, the ball bursts off his fingers and rolls down to the fence for a boundary. This could  surely be the turning point of the game now!
Slower full delivery on off, George drives it towards mid off and sets off. Rehmat Shah has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A single taken.

Leg bye! A shout for an LBW! Angles in a length delivery on middle, Kevin looks to flick it across the line but misses as the ball goes off the pads towards the off side. Zadran is busy appealing for an LBW but the height seems to be an issue there. The pair crosses for a leg bye.
Back of a length ball outside off, Dockrell taps it towards covers for a single.
On the stumps, flicked down to long on for one.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven down to long off where Rehmat Shah fumbles and that brings back Kevin O'Brien on strike.
Full and around off, George defends it into the ground. A wicket maiden for the leggie, what an over.
Quicker through the air outside off, Dockrell looks to cut but gets a bottom edge on the boots.
A straighter one around middle, nudged towards mid-wicket.
Flatter one around middle, Dockrell punches it towards covers.
Tossed up around off, pushed back to the bowler.
GEORGE DOCKRELL is the new man in.

OUT! Gary Wilson holes out! Rashid Khan provides a much-needed breakthrough and has brought life back into this contest. Bowls a half-tracker around off, Wilson camps back and looks to murder the pull over mid-wicket but doesn't get enough meat on it. He finds the fielder, Mohammad Nabi near the ropes who makes no mistake. A timely wicket for the Afghans as they break the 66-run stand. Can the hosts sneak in a few more?
RASHID KHAN is back into the attack!
A high full toss outside off, Wilson lofts it towards covers and luckily it falls in a safe zone. Just a single taken. 25 required from 42 balls now!
The batsman manages only a bottom edge on that one.
Fuller again outside off, driven straight to the ground.
15th ODI fifty for Kevin O'Brien.

FIFTY UP FOR KEVIN! He was struggling, got retired hurt but has fought like a brave lad. Can he take his team over the line? Tries for a yorker but bowls a low full toss on off, Kevin O'Brien drives it towards mid off for a single.
Short and outside off, close to off stump line as Wilson chops it towards third man for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, punched nicely towards sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller on the pads, worked a bit uppishly through mid-wicket for a single. 29 needed from 48 balls!
Fuller ball on middle, knocked down to long on for a single.

A loud shout for LBW! Very full and sprayed outside off, Wilson stays leg side to blast this one through covers but misses and it goes towards Shahzad behind. Naib heard something and hence appeals long and hard for a caught behind. The umpire, however, stays unmoved. Maybe, the sound would have been off the bat hitting the ground. A few words are being exchanged between Kevin O'Brien and Rashid Khan.
Rolls his fingers around off, clipped towards mid-wicket for a single.
An off pace delivery on off, a punchy drive straight to mid off.
Fuller length delivery outside off, drilled through covers for a single.
Short outside off, Wilson looks to cut but gets a bottom edge towards point for a single. 33 needed from 9 overs!
Fullish in length and around off, driven towards covers.

Back of a length ball on middle, pulled powerfully towards deep mid-wicket. Luckily it goes on the bounce to the fielder there. A single taken. My colleague exclaims, what power this lad has! He is amazed by his short-arm jabs.
Angles in a length delivery on middle, the batsman looks to pull it across the line but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls towards the off side.
A loud shout for LBW! Fuller in length and just around off, Kevin defends it by keeping his bat close to the pads. The bowler appeals but nothing from the umpire.

FOUR! CRACKING SHOT! Slightly short around off stump and O'Brien clobbers the pull in front of square pm the leg side. Superb shot and the fielder in the deep has a desperate attempt to stop the boundary but cannot.
DAWLAT ZADRAN is back on.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Five fielders allowed outside the ring now. Not sure if Afghanistan will go for that defensive strategy with just 39 needed from 60 balls.
Very full around middle, leans across and digs it out down the pitch.
Slower ball outside off, tapped towards point.
Length ball on middle and leg, clipped towards short fine leg. Won't get the single.
Good length attacking the stumps, Wilson is rock solid in defence.
In the channel outside off, Wilson dabs it towards point.
Slow yorker around middle, gets across and gets it off the toe end to short fine leg for a single. Muted appeal for lbw but there was only bat involved.
GULBADIN NAIB is back on.
Fuller on the pads, leans across and clips it behind square leg for a single.

Tossed up around off, Kevin goes straighter this time with a lofted stroke down the ground. Long off goes across to his right to cut it off and save a couple for his side. 50-run stand comes up and what a superb one it has been for Ireland.
The leg break and Kevin doesn't pick it at all and misses the mighty slog sweep.
Fuller around off, leans across and works it towards mid on.
Loopy around middle, nudged towards short mid-wicket for a brisk single.
Floated outside off, presses forward and defends well.
Flighted on the sticks, whipped away down to long on for a single.
Fuller around middle, gets across and sweeps it to short fine leg.
Lovely off break around middle, spins in to rap Kevin on the front pad. Stifled lbw appeal but probably an inside edge there. Turned too much as well.
Flatter around middle, Kevin stays back and pushes it down to long on for a single.
Slightly short outside off, O'Brien sits back and slaps it to deep backward point for a brace.
Floated outside off, looks to drive but gets it off the inner half towards backward square leg.
MOHAMMAD NABI is back on.
Sliding in around middle, bunted off the back foot towards mid on. Good comeback by Rashid after going for a biggie off the first ball of the over.
Looped up outside off, reaches out and blocks it firmly.
Fuller outside off, O'Brien reaches out and pats it towards cover-point for a quick single.
Flighted outside off, leans forward and dabs at it with an angled bat towards point.
Flatter around leg stump, misses the sweep and is hit on the pads.

SIX! CLOBBERED! Kevin O'Brien is toying with the leg spinner here. Picks the wrong 'un early and dumps it over deep mid-wicket with a mighty slog sweep for a huge maximum. Ireland in cruise control mode here.
Fuller and outside off, driven down the ground to long off for a single.
Tossed up outside off, played with soft hands towards the gully region.
Fuller and outside off, leans into it and blocks firmly to cover.
Quicker ball outside off, Wilson gets back and nudges it to short cover for a brisk single.
Flatter outside off, sits back and punches it down to long off for a single.
Flatter and short outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller on the pads, worked to deep mid-wicket for a single. 18 off the over!

Five wides! Rashid is losing the plot and this could be the match-changing over. Tries the googly but the line is on leg stump, spins down the leg side and past Shahzad towards the fine leg fence as Wilson misses the flick.
Fuller outside off, leans  forward to chip it down the ground. Doesn't carry to the fielder there and the batsmen take a single.
FOUR! THERE HE GOES AGAIN! Rashid drops it short around middle, Kevin camps on the back foot expecting this length and hammers the pull over mid-wicket. The ball races to the fence for a boundary.

SIX! NAILED! Flighted around off, Kevin gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it cleanly over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Superb shot! He isn't going to let the leggie settle. We are in for some entertainment.
BEATEN! Floated outside off, spins away to beat the outside edge.
Floated around leg stump, gets across and clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! FINE SHOT! Drifting in from around off, O'Brien makes a bit of room and chips it over the covers with an inside out lofted stroke. Excellent footwork and made good connection to clear the infield. Momentum in the chase now.
Full and outside off, presses forward and blocks well.
Flighted around middle, gets across and sweeps it to short fine leg.
On the shorter side around middle, pulled away down to wide long on for a single.
Flighted outside off, Wilson pushes at it but it goes off the edge that flies through backward point for a brace.

FOUR! PUMMELED! Hamza starts with a half-tracker around middle, Wilson sits back and nails the pull cleanly over mid-wicket for a boundary. Struck it really well but that's not the length Hamza should be bowling.
AMIR HAMZA is back on!
Fuller on middle, worked away through mid-wicket for a single.

Lovely googly outside off, Wilson looks to defend but gets an inside edge on to the pad and the ball is up in the air for a while. Shahzad runs forward towards the short leg region but the ball dies down before he can reach it.
Flatter around middle, Wilson goes well across to sweep but gets it off the pad.
Tossed up gently around middle, smothered well off the front foot on to the track.
Another half-tracker around middle, keeps low and O'Brien does well to pull it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and short around off, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated around off, blocked off the front foot towards the mid-wicket.
KEVIN O'BRIEN is back to bat! His side needs him to bail them out. Can he do so?
Drinks break!

OUT! Knocked him over! Nabi has his fourth and Ireland are in strife now. Lovely off break around middle, turns away sharply to beat the edge as McBrine looks to defend. The ball disturbs the stumps and that's another major blow to Ireland. Afghanistan are on top.
Looped up around middle, McBrine blocks it firmly off the front foot.
Flighted around middle, reaches out to that one and defends solidly with a straight bat.
Flatter around off, gets back and clips it through mid-wicket. Good running and they pick up another brace.
Floated on a length outside off, gets back to steer it just past a diving backward point for a brace.
Fuller outside off, drilled down the ground to long off for a single.

Four Leg byes! Cracking ball! The googly and McBrine hasn't picked it at all. Looks to block but the ball spins away to go off the thigh pad and gets through between keeper and first slip to the fence.
On a length around off, turning in, blocked off the back foot to short mid-wicket.
ANDY MCBRINE walks in next!
BOLDSTARTS Andy McBrine BOLDENDS will walk into the middle next to bat.

OUT! GONE THIS TIME! Peach of a delivery from Rashid as he bowls a leg break around off, turns in sharply into Thompson who looks to block at it from the crease. The ball sneaks through him and crashes into the sticks. Quality leg spin bowling.
BEATEN! Floated around off, turns in sharply as Thompson is beaten on the push. That was very close to the edge and also not far away from the off pole.
Floated around the stumps, swept through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Smacked! Tossed up around off, Thompson absolutely through covers to find the fence. Had to reach out for that one and in the end gets the desired result.
Full and quicker around off, stays low as Thompson does well to keep it out.
Full around off, ST looks to sweep and gets beaten once more.
Full and quicker through the air around off, Stuart Thompson is beaten on the poke.
Flatter around middle, tucked past the mid on fielder for a single.
Full around off, driven through covers for a single.
A googly around middle, skidding through, Gary goes back to flick but is lucky to get an inside edge on the pads.
Goes back and flicks it through mid-wicket for a double.
Floats it up around middle, Wilson looks to flick but gets a leading edge back to Khan.
Full around off, defended off the front foot gently.
Flat and outside off, cut towards backward point.
A loud shout for LBW! Tossed up around off, Wilson gets down to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. A crying appeal for an LBW but it's turned down. Impact was well outside off.
Flat around off, GW taps it towards covers and scurries through for a quick single.
Fires it full on the stumps, Wilson blocks it out.
Short and around middle, punched towards mid on.
Flattish around off, defended down gently.
Full and outside off, Thompson takes a good stride forward to drive but gets it off the outer part past a diving backward point fielder for a single.
Tossed up around off, driven towards covers for nothing.
Straighter one around middle and off, blocked into the ground.
Googly around off, pushed down to long off for a single.
Outside off, swept it along the ground through square leg for a single.
Slider around off, Gary leaves it alone.
FOUR! Poor ball and duly punished! Drops it short on off, Wilson goes back and pounces on it. He pulls it with disdain through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Loopy ball outside off, driven towards covers.
RASHID KHAN into the attack now! A slip and silly point in place...
Loops it up outside off, the batsman looks to drive but gets it off the outer half towards backward point.
Flat and quicker one outside off, punched through cover-point for a single.
Loopy ball outside off, driven down to long off for a single.
Floats it up around off, defended into the ground.
Loopy full around off, driven straight to the man at short extra cover.
STUART THOMPSON is the next man in!

OUT! BOWLING CHANGE WORKS INSTANTLY! It's that man, Nabi, who has done it. Pushed through quicker around off, a hint of turn into Balbirnie who was stuck on the back foot. A bit of low bounce and it sneaks through to rattle the furniture behind him. The Afghanis are elated. Ireland need 119 more runs to win this match.
MOHAMMAD NABI is back on.
Floated around middle, gets across and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single. Wanted the second run but is sent back.
Fuller around off, leans across and drives it down to long on for a single.
Drifting in from outside off, a bit of turn again and Wilson nudges it towards point with the spin.
RIPPER! Floated around off, Wilson looks to flick but is beaten by the excessive turn as the ball whizzes past the edge.
Floated around middle, gets across and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Tossed up wider outside off, driven gently towards point.
Loopy ball around off, swept through square leg for a single.
Comes a bit forward and pushes it towards the off side for a single.
Leg bye! Full around leg, flicked towards fine leg for a single. It came off the pads actually so a leg bye taken.
Around off, swept towards the man at square leg.
Full and fired outside off, it's left alone.
Flighted around leg, wristed through mid-wicket for a couple.
Tossed up around leg, pushed towards long on for a single.
Flat and short on off, tapped towards cover-point for a single.
Darts it around middle, flicked to square leg for a single.

FOUR! Edged and though! Tossed up outside off, Balbirnie makes room to drive but gets an outside edge. Rashid Khan at first slip is a bit late to react and the ball flies between the keeper and him and races down for a boundary.
Short and outside off, punched off the back foot through covers for one.
Quicker through the air, defended into the ground.
AMIR HAMZA is back.
FOUR! One bounce and into the ropes! Floats it up around off, Andy Balbirnie comes down the track, hits it with the spin over extra cover for a boundary.
Flatter outside off, turns away a touch, Balbirnie shoulders his arms.
Quicker through the air outside off, Andy gets back and leaves it alone.
Gets on the front foot and drives it past covers for a single.
Floats it up around off, driven towards the man at covers.
A loopy full toss around off, driven through point for a single.
RAHMAT SHAH into the attack now!
FOUR! Beautiful! Fuller in length and served wide outside off, Wilson leans into it and drives it excellently to beat the dive of the man at short extra cover and finds the fence.
Back of a length ball outside off, punched square of the wicket on the off side for nothing.
Fuller length delivery on middle, driven towards mid on. They look for a single but is sent back.
Fuller and angling in, the batsman gets across and pushes it towards mid on.
Fuller length delivery served outside off, a punchy drive attempted but straight to covers.
Fuller and sprayed on the pads, flicked in front of square for a single.
Flighted around middle, swept away through square leg for a single.
Loopy outside off, turns away to beat the edge as Balbirnie looks to block.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and defends solidly.
Floated around middle, swept towards short fine leg makes a good stop.
Drifting in from outside off, blocked solidly off the front foot.
GARY WILSON walks out to bat.
Kevin O'Brien is walking off the field retired hurt. Seems to be in some sort of discomfort.
Flighted around middle, blocked off the front foot towards cover-point.
Fuller ball around leg stump, Balbirnie misses the flick and it goes off the pads down to fine leg. The batsmen take a leg bye.
Shortish around off, Balbirnie goes back and pulls it through square leg for a single.
Fuller and around off, driven firmly back down the track and Zadran makes a good stop in his followthrough. Fires a throw at the keeper's end to show aggression.
Back of a length outside off, sits back and blocks it firmly towards the off side.
Length ball outside off, stays back and punches it towards mid off for a single.
Length ball around off, angled in, worked through square leg for a single.
DAWLAT ZADRAN returns.
Fuller on off, leans across and works it towards long on for a single.
IN THE AIR.....SAFE! Floated around off, looks to work across the line but gets a leading edge that flies past cover towards the deep for a single.
Fuller ball outside off, leans into it and blocks solidly.
Flatter and around off, defended off the front foot towards short cover.
Drifting in from around middle, swept away through backward square leg for a single.
Floated outside off, Balbirnie pushes at it but is beaten. Good ball!
AMIR HAMZA is back on.
Drinks break....
FOUR! EASY RUNS! Length ball on middle and leg, Kevin O'Brien gets across and flicks it away elegantly through mid-wicket to find the fence. Nice timing on the shot.
On middle and leg, leans across and clips it to the leg side.
Fullish ball outside off, K O'Brien gets across and pushes it towards mid off.
Fuller around middle, leans across and clips it behind square on the leg side for a brace.
Pitched up outside off, driven crisply to short cover who gets a hand to parry it towards the cover fielder.
Fuller ball around off, gets across a touch and wrists it towards mid on.
Fuller outside off, reaches out and defends it solidly.
Loopy around middle, Balbirnie gets across and flicks it towards the leg side.
WAS THERE AN EDGE? Not sure and we might have to take another look at it. Flatter outside off, Balbirnie pushes at it as the ball goes through to Shahzad who spills it.
Flighted outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked gently to the leg side.
KEVIN O'BRIEN is the new man in.

OUT! GONE! Another massive strike for Afghanistan! Floated off break outside off, Porterfield reaches out to push at it and as a result, comes out of his crease a bit. He gets beaten by the turn and Shahzad whips off the bails in a flash before appealing confidently. The umpires go upstairs to check the stumping and replays confirm that Porterfield's foot hadn't got back into the crease.
Massive moment in this game as this is a huge wicket for the hosts.
They are going upstairs to check a stumping against Porterfield. Shahzad is very confident.
Good length outside off, Balbirnie steers it towards point.
Pitched up around off, leans across and blocks it solidly down the track.
Fuller and around off, Balbirnie is squared up on the push and the ball goes off the edge towards point.

JUST SHORT! Slower ball around off, Balbirnie pushes at it but is undone by the lack of pace. Gets a thin edge on it but the ball doesn't carry to Shahzad who dives forward in an attempt to take the catch.
Speared wider outside off, no shot offered to that one.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Superb ball from Naib and Joyce has to walk back. Full and on leg stump, Joyce looks to block but the ball straightens after pitching to sneak through him. The sticks are disturbed. Timely strike for Afghanistan. Ireland need 162 more from 215 balls.
Fuller outside off, Joyce thumps the drive towards mid off where it is well stopped.
Quicker ball around off, comes in with the angle and Joyce works it to short mid-wicket for a quick single.
Fuller outside off, Joyce leans into it and blocks firmly towards cover.
Loopy and outside off, leans into it and taps the ball towards cover.
Fuller outside off, stroked down to long off for a single.
Floated outside leg stump, misses the sweep and wide called. There was an appeal for caught behind from Shahzad but the umpire isn't bothered.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and blocks strongly towards short cover.
Fuller ball attacking the stumps, leans across and defends it solidly.
Length ball outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Fuller ball around off, Porterfield looks to drive but gets it off the inner half towards mid on.
Length ball outside off, Joyce drives it down the ground. Cannot beat mid off who moves to his right to make a stop. Single taken.
Full and outside off, presses forward and blocks it solidly towards cover.
Fuller on the pads, leans across and tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Drifting in from outside off, Joyce hangs his bat at it but is beaten.
Full and outside off, presses forward and blocks it towards cover.
Floated outside off, Williams pushes at it but gets an inside edge on the leg side for a single.
Loopy and outside off, leans forward and pushes it down the ground to long off for a run.
Flighted outside off, driven down the ground to long off for a single.
BEATEN! Flatter and outside off, Porterfield plays for the turn but this skids through off the deck to beat the edge.
Fine yorker around middle, Joyce does well dig it out towards cover.
Fuller ball outside off, Joyce crisply drives it towards mid off.
Length ball outside off, presses forward and mistimes the drive towards extra cover where it is well stopped.
Fuller ball around leg stump, gets across and defends it firmly to short mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, Joyce nudges it towards short third man for a single.
On middle and leg, gets across and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
GULBADIN NAIB is back.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Four fielders are now allowed outside the ring.
Bowls a round-arm action and lands it around off, Porterfield blocks it back to the bowler.
Full around off, defended into the ground.

Edged but doesn't carry! Loopy delivery around off, Porterfield comes forward to defend but gets an outside edge which falls just short of Rashid Khan at first slip. Nabi making an impact straightaway.
WILLIAM PORTERFIELD is the new man in.

OUT! Soft dismissal! Slows it through the air around middle, Paul Stirling comes down the track to give it a go but is beaten by the flight here. He ends up chipping it straight to Shafiqullah Shafiq at short mid-wicket who makes no mistake. Nabi strikes in his very first over and gets a big fish!
Drifting it on the pads, clipped behind square on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Joyce welcomes Nabi into the attack! Starts off with a short ball outside off, Ed Joyce quickly camps back and packs a punch past covers for a boundary. That sped away to the fence.
MOHAMMAD NABI comes on to bowl.
Goes back and dabs it towards point.

FOUR! Good use of the feet! Tossed up around middle and leg, Stirling skips down the track and flicks it beautifully over mid-wicket to find the fence again. After a slow start, Ireland have picked up pace.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
That's beaudyyyyy! Lands it around middle, gets it to turn away with some bounce as Stirling comes forward to defend but misses. The ball just about kisses the off pole. Lovely bowling Hamza!
Straighter one around middle, Stirling misses his flick and is hit on the pads.

In the air... falls short! Floats it up around off, Joyce comes down the track to flick it with the turn towards mid-wicket. It goes uppishly towards short mid-wicket as the fielder looks to catch it with a dive forward but it falls well short of him.
AMIR HAMZA is back on.
Gets forward and across to drive it past covers. The sweeper cover cuts it off and keeps them down to a couple.
Full on the stumps, patted back to Gulbadin.

FOUR! Deft touch, that's really deft! Naib goes wide of the crease and serves a length delivery outside off, Stirling just opens the face of the bat and glides it ever so nicely down to third man for a boundary. He just doesn't have raw power but has good timing too.
On a length and it moves away off the deck, Paul prods forward to defend but the ball just about kisses the willow and goes on the bounce to Shahzad.
Fuller on middle, flicked through square leg for a single.
Fuller and sliding down the leg side, Joyce misses his flick and Shahzad behind the stumps dives to his right to stop it.

FOUR! Bad ball! A low full toss on the pads, Stirling looks to whip it across the line but didn't time it well. The ball falls safely in front of square on the leg side for a boundary. There was a fielder coming in to stop that but to no avail.
Leans forward to a full ball and drives it towards covers.

A loud shout for caught behind! On a length and zips through the surface as Stirling with no footwork looks to punch it on the up. The ball whizzes past the outside edge to Shahzad who collects it and starts to appeal. The umpire shows no interest.
SIX! THAT'S PAULY-GOOD! Back of a length ball on off, comes up at a nice height too. Stirling stays put and nails the pull shot over wide long on for a biggie all the way. Struck that really well!
A low full toss outside off, Joyce drives but finds the man at short extra cover. The fielder fumbles and they take a single.
Fuller on off, driven off the front foot towards mid off.
DAWLAT ZADRAN has a change of ends.
Fuller outside off, driven on the up towards point for nothing.
Touch short and outside off, tapped away towards the backward point fielder.
Beaten again! Fuller and served outside off, Stirling looks to drive again and is beaten all ends up.
